name: RAXIO GROUP
notes: Raxio Group is Africa’s premier carrier-neutral data centre operator, developing a growing portfolio of Tier III-certified, carrier- and peering-neutral facilities across the continent. Our data centres are digital connectivity hubs, bringing together network carriers, cloud service providers and Internet Exchange Points (IXPs). Raxio enables customers to connect, peer and scale through secure, resilient and carrier-neutral environments built to support Africa’s growing digital ecosystem.
